description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Contract Hero, adding {C}{C}.
When Contract Hero dies, Mazzy's second ability and Gift of Immortality trigger.
Resolve the Mazzy trigger, exiling Gift of Immortality with the ability to cast it until end of your next turn.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger, returning Contract Hero from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Contract Hero enters, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Cast Gift of Immortality from exile by paying {2}{W}, attaching it to Contract Hero.
Repeat.
